items.question: Will the core reach an IETF working group?
items.context: The draft is an individual submission; its first name expired before renewal under a new name, and mpp.dev's standards-track wording is stronger than the Datatracker record.

items.question: Will session become a standardized intent?
items.context: The contribution rules need two methods, and six methods already define session, yet PR #280 closed unmerged on 2026-09-28.

items.question: How much MPP activity is real commerce?
items.context: MPPscan's last 30 days average under one cent per transaction, and 126 of 129 directory listings accept Tempo.

items.question: Does Stripe's reported 1.5 percent stablecoin fee apply to MPP charges?
items.context: Reported in December 2025; the current Stripe page states no percentage and the MPP docs list only minimums.

items.question: Should channels expire?
items.context: Channels and vouchers have no expiry; servers are only advised to close idle channels after about 30 days.

items.question: Will MPP gain a user authorization object, or rely on AP2-style mandates?
items.context: MPP carries no user mandate, and no specification binds it to AP2.

items.question: Will Mastercard publish an MPP method or statement of its own?
items.context: Only Tempo's quote inside Mastercard's release exists; no method spec.

items.question: What do the 40 Tamarin findings mean for MPP specifically?
items.context: The abstract does not break the findings out per protocol.
